title: AIA Core Definitions
description: Shared $defs for Agent Identity Attestation (AIA) draft-00 schemas. See agent-identity-attestation/draft-arkavo-aia-00.md.

AiaSpec.description: Version of the AIA specification an AID conforms to. AIA spec §4.2.

RFC3339.description: RFC 3339 / ISO 8601 timestamp with explicit timezone

Nonce.description: 128-bit nonce, base64url-encoded without padding (22 chars). Replay defense per AIA spec §10.4.

Blake3Digest.description: BLAKE3 digest, 'blake3:' followed by base64url. AIA reuses SwarmKit's BLAKE3 content addressing (AIA spec §4.12, §5.2).

FlightId.description: UUID identifying a single SwarmFlight execution. Equals the SwarmKit delegation envelope flight_id.

RoleId.description: Role identifier, unique within a SwarmKit

RoleType.description: SwarmKit mesh archetype. Free-form per SwarmKit §4.3 Appendix C; AIA adds the recommended value 'identity_authority' (AIA spec §1.3, §4.3).

AgentType.description: Coarse functional class of an agent, e.g. 'coding', 'orchestrator', 'identity_authority', 'research'. Free-form. Populates OpenTDF attribute agent.identity.type (AIA spec §3.5, §4.3).

TrustLevel.description: Strength of attestation behind a credential. 'attested' = hardware-rooted evidence; 'asserted' = software-only evidence; 'unverified' = no acceptable evidence. Populates agent.identity.trust_level (AIA spec §4.3).

RuntimeLocus.description: Coarse runtime locus. Distinct from runtime_attestation.backend (the inference engine). Populates agent.identity.runtime (AIA spec §4.3).

Capability.description: A coarse protocol/interface capability an agent speaks, e.g. 'a2a', 'mcp'. Descriptive identity, NOT authorization (AIA spec §4.3, §3.5).

Jwk.description: Public JSON Web Key for proof-of-possession. AIA spec §4.6. The value 'none' MUST NOT be used and symmetric algorithms MUST NOT be used.

y.description: Required for EC keys; absent for OKP.

ModelInfo.description: Model identity: family, parameter size, quantization. Mirrors SwarmKit agent_provisioning.model so an AID can be checked against the kit. AIA spec §5.2.
